mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate level (FEDFUNDS < 0.1%) consistently precedes positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns due to reduced cost of capital for equity financing and valuation, with the signal active at all times without threshold requirement.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.1% over a 5-year rolling window, or the Rank IC for FEDFUNDS is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeding 0.5 percentage points over a 3-month period signals deteriorating labor market conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances meeting the trigger condition over a 5-year rolling window, or the Rank IC for UNRATE is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: The joint decline in housing starts (HOUST) and GDP growth (GDPC1) below 1.5% annualized signals a contraction in the demand for goods and services, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances meeting the trigger condition over a 5-year rolling window, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Strong industrial production growth (INDPRO > 2.0% annualized) signals robust manufacturing output and economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns as investors anticipate sustained corporate profitability.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO growth > 2.0% over a 5-year rolling window, or the Rank IC for INDPRO is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the CPI (CPIAUCSL) exceeding 0.3% signals accelerating inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, which results in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances meeting the trigger condition over a 5-year rolling window, or the Rank IC for CPIAUCSL is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: The joint condition of weak payroll growth (PAYEMS growth < 0.5%) and restrictive monetary policy (FEDFUNDS > 0.5%) signals a labor market contraction combined with tight financial conditions, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: labor market weakness with tight policy
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances meeting the trigger condition over a 5-year rolling window, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when RSAFS growth > 1.0% over a 5-year rolling window, or the Rank IC for RSAFS is below 0.03.
